1. (Currently amended) A method for synchronous triggering of events in multiple modules, each module receiving a serial bit stream over a respective communications link, each said communications link comprising a data out and a clock line, each said clock line derived from a single clock source, the method comprising the steps of: transmitting a send packet over said data out line to each module synchronous with said clock source wherein said send packet contains at least one bit position defined as a trigger bit, __wherein said trigger bit is distinct from data bits in said send packet__, and triggering an event in a respective one of said modules upon receipt of a respective one of said at least one trigger bit __wherein said event is triggered by recognition of said trigger bit as a control signal separate from data transmission__.

2. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises __synchronous__ waveform digitization __initiated upon receipt of said trigger bit__.

3. (Original) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises waveform synthesis.

4. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 1 said communications link further comprising a data in line and further comprising receiving a serial bit stream over said data in line comprising a receive packet from each said module, wherein a predefined bit in each said receive packet comprises an indication that a measurement is triggered __by said trigger bit__.

5. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 4 wherein said receive packet from each module further comprises a plurality of bits reflecting __temporally synchronized__ results of said triggered measurement __initiated by said trigger bit__.

11. (Currently amended) An apparatus for performing synchronous triggering of events in multiple modules comprising a housing comprising a controller and receiving two or more modules, a respective serial communications link between said controller and each of said two or more modules, each said communications link comprising a data out and a clock line, each said clock line derived from a single clock source, means for transmitting a send packet over said data out line to each module synchronous with said clock source wherein said send packet contains at least one bit position defined as a trigger bit __wherein said trigger bit is distinct from data bits in said send packet__, and means in each said module for triggering a module specific event upon receipt of respective ones of said trigger bits __wherein said event is triggered by recognition of said trigger bit as a control signal separate from data transmission__.

12. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises __synchronous__ waveform digitization __initiated upon receipt of said trigger bit__.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises __synchronous__ waveform digitization __on at least one channel__ and waveform synthesis __on at least one separate channel of said module, wherein said digitization and synthesis are initiated upon receipt of respective trigger bits__.

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 said communications link further comprising a data in line and further comprising means for receiving a serial bit stream over said data in line comprising a receive packet from each said module, wherein a predefined bit in each said receive packet comprises an indication that a measurement is triggered __by said trigger bit__.

15. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 14 wherein said receive packet from each module further comprises a plurality of bits reflecting __temporally synchronized__ results of said triggered measurement __initiated by said trigger bit__.

16. (Original) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises waveform synthesis.
